synopsis: In this gender-bending rom-com manga, one young man's wish for love will change him—literally! Uesugi Keisuke has always struggled with being short and adorable compared to his super smart and tall best friend. One day, he overhears his crush comment, "Wouldn't he be the cutest if he was a girl?!" This makes him worry she doesn't even see him as a guy. Down in the dumps, he prays at the shrine next to his house in the hopes that he can still achieve young love. However, it seems there was a major misunderstanding, because when his prayer is answered, he winds up transformed into a girl! Thus begins Uesugi's gender-bent love triangle! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: LORD
titleNative: 覇-LORD-
synopsis: The story is set in the period from the end of the Later Han Dynasty to the Three Kingdoms Period in China. In 184 AD, a brave general of the Nanukoku Kingdom, who contributed to Himiko's unification of Japan, decides to take over the "hegemony" of the Later Han Dynasty. He travels alone to Yushu in the Later Han Dynasty, where he meets the three brothers Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei. He works with these three brothers, but soon learns that Liu Bei is an evil person. One day, Liu Bei tries to kill a criminal to test his new sword, but Pei Yu stops him and even cuts off Liu Bei's head. Guan Yu and Zhang Fei are outraged, but Pei Yu sees and points out that the two were not following Liu Bei out of pure heart. Afterwards, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei witnessed Puo Yu's actions and thoughts and decided to make Puo Yu the new Liu Bei, and the three of them took a new oath of brotherhood in Taoyuan. Note: The story is loosely based on the Three Kingdoms period, using both real and original characters and events from the historical period in Chinese history and folklore of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

synopsis: At 24, Reina Izutsu has recently become the new president of Izutsu Printing after taking over for her late father. Young and not quite experienced, Reina wants to do her best but unfortunately comes across as harsh with her employees. Stressed and feeling lost, Reina spends an evening drowning her sorrows in beer at an empty park. She rants and vents out loud to the starry sky that she wants to give up and quit being president, just letting off steam. Except, she fails to realize that her subordinate, 37-year-old section chief Kenichi Ishizumi, heard her drunken ramblings! But rather than use this against her, Kenichi finds himself charmed by the young woman. He vows then and there to support her and help her find her way as company president, no matter what! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

The wizard Arvel meets his end at the hands of his fiancée, Seraphina, who would later become the emperor's mistress and a notorious villainess. However, when he comes to, he finds himself face-to-face with a young Seraphina! Astonishingly, he has returned to the body of his 13-year-old self. Seeing the young and still innocent Seraphina, Arvel decides he will help her become a proper lady and save his own life in the process. To start, he must find a way to prevent the death of his brother, Shou, who was once engaged to Seraphina. However, the situation is far from simple, as he must contend with Seraphina's neglectful family, other men vying for the beautiful Seraphina's attention, and a web of conflicting plots. Given a second chance, can Arvel alter Seraphina's fate and save her from becoming a villainess…!? (Source: Bushiroad, translated)

She recently recovered from a two-year coma caused by a traffic accident. Prior to the traffic accident, she originally had two personalities, a male personality named Shiki (織), and the original female personality Shiki (式). Children born into the Ryōgi family are generally male and are raised with two personalities, so the male personality is customarily called the "yang" personality, while the female is called the "yin" personality. It is easy to tell which Shiki is speaking at a given time because they both have a distinct style of speaking, most notably that the female Shiki refers to herself with the pronoun watashi (私), while male Shiki refers to himself as ore (オレ). After waking from her coma, Shiki discovers that she can no longer feel the male Shiki's presence and assumes that he died because of the accident. Mankind stands no chance of prevailing against the most powerful being in the world and her army of loyal minions—until a band of heroes bests her in an epic battle, sealing her soul away for all eternity. So it's no big deal to the boy behind Lufas when he logs off after his epic defeat—thankfully, it won't really be eternity until he can play again. Two hundred years have passed since Lufas's defeat, and Mizgarz now lives under the shadow of the Devil King. How will our hero fix his mess? title: Lord of Fate: When Mutation Strikes
titleRomaji: Ming Lun Zhi Zhu! Dang Yibian Jiang Lin Renjian
titleEnglish: Lord of Fate: When Mutation Strikes
titleNative: 命轮之主! 当异变降临人间
synonyms: The Lord of the Wheel of Destiny
Lord of the Wheel of Fortune! When Changes Come to the World
synopsis: Ever since the emergence of Phantom Star mutated plants and animals on earth into deadly monsters called beast gods, humanity has been on the brink of being wiped out. It was only when explorers who traveled to Phantom Star returned with formidable power that humans were able to start fighting back. Like countless others, Jiang Kai also traveled to Phantom Star in hopes of earning great strength. However, after overcoming brutal conditions and bloodthirsty monsters, he discovers that his profession is a gambler, a rare job that is not granted so easily. (Source: Tappytoon)

title: Seijo no Ane Desu ga, Imouto no Tame no Tokushu Maseki ya Tokushu Yakusou no Saishu wo Yametara, Ringoku no Majutsushi-sama no Moto de Shiawase ni Narimashita!
titleRomaji: Seijo no Ane Desu ga, Imouto no Tame no Tokushu Maseki ya Tokushu Yakusou no Saishu wo Yametara, Ringoku no Majutsushi-sama no Moto de Shiawase ni Narimashita!
titleNative: 聖女の姉ですが、妹のための特殊魔石や特殊薬草の採取をやめたら、隣国の魔術師様の元で幸せになりました！
synopsis: The main character, a young girl named Sherry, is an excellent "gatherer" who collects special herbs and magic stones. She became a gatherer to help her only relative, her younger sister Irene, a saint, but when Irene comes of age and is engaged, she abandons her and tells her to disappear somewhere. Sherry decides to leave her country and heads for the neighboring Rogue Kingdom, where magic is thriving. Along the way, she meets Aslan, a handsome magician from the Rogue Kingdom... This is the Cinderella story of a gathering nerd who turns her life around. (Source: Natalie, translated)

title: The Black Swindler
titleNative: クロサギ
synopsis: White swindlers (shirosagi) are those that cheat people to take their money, red swindlers (akasagi) are those that swindle the opposite sex, and black swindlers (kurosagi) are those that cheat the white and red swindlers. After his family is swindled by white swindlers, Kurosagi sets out to avenge them by becoming a black swindler. (Source: Anime News Network)
